units.source_text: 有一天时雨霏霏，昼静人闲，匂皇子来到大公主房中。

en.t: One day, as a cold drizzle fell and the quiet afternoon left people at leisure, Prince Niou came to the Eldest Princess's room.

units.source_text: 此时大公主身边侍女不多，她正在静静地观赏图画。

en.t: At the time, there were not many attendants around the Eldest Princess, and she was quietly looking at some pictures.

units.source_text: 匂皇子隔着帷屏和她谈话。

en.t: Prince Niou spoke with her through a curtain screen.

units.source_text: 他一向认为这位胞姐品性高雅无比，加之容姿妩媚温柔，多年以来不曾见过第二人。

en.t: He had always thought this sister of his was unsurpassed in refinement, and that her charming, gentle beauty was unlike anyone he had seen in many years.

units.source_text: 他觉得世间女子没有人比得上她的品貌。

en.t: He felt that no woman in the world could match her in grace and appearance.

units.source_text: 只有冷泉院的公主，世间声望甚高，家中教养又好，听说是很可爱的。

en.t: Only the princess of Reizei-in, who had a very high reputation and excellent upbringing, was said to be truly lovely.

units.source_text: 他心中恋慕，但一向不曾出之于口。

en.t: He cherished longing for her in his heart, but he had never spoken of it aloud.

units.source_text: 然而他今天看到了大公主，想道：“山庄里那个人，优美高雅之姿决不亚于我这位姐姐。”

en.t: Yet today, seeing the Eldest Princess, he thought, "The lady at the mountain villa is certainly no less graceful and refined than this sister of mine."

units.source_text: 一想起二女公子，便不胜恋慕。

en.t: As soon as he thought of the Second Princess, he was overcome with longing.

units.source_text: 为欲慰情，拿起散放在身边的画幅来欣赏，但见画着的都是各种美女的姿态，其中又画着所恋的男子的家屋。

en.t: Trying to soothe his feelings, he picked up the paintings scattered near him and looked at them, only to find that they showed all kinds of beautiful women, along with the houses of the men they loved.

units.source_text: 这是画家潜心模拟出来的人世诸相，有许多可使他联想宇治山庄。

en.t: These were scenes of human life carefully imagined by the painter, and many of them reminded him of the villa at Uji.

units.source_text: 他颇感兴味，便向大公主索得数幅，欲以贻赠宇治的二女公子。

en.t: He found them quite interesting, so he asked the Eldest Princess for several of them, intending to send them as a gift to the Second Princess at Uji.

units.source_text: 其中有描写在五中将故事的画，绘的是在五中将教他妹妹弹琴，题上“应有人来摘”之诗。

en.t: Among them was a painting of the tale of Zaigo no Chujo, showing the captain teaching his younger sister to play the koto, with the poem "Someone should come to pluck them" inscribed on it.

units.source_text: 匂皇子看了，不知起了什么感想，稍稍靠近帷屏，低声向大公主说道：“嫡亲兄妹之间，古代的人也不用隔离，习以为常。

en.t: When Prince Niou saw it, some feeling stirred in him; he moved a little closer to the curtain screen and said softly to the Eldest Princess, "In ancient times, even full brothers and sisters did not keep themselves apart, and people thought nothing of it.

units.source_text: 你却对我这等疏远。”

en.t: Yet you treat me with such distance."

units.source_text: 大公主不知道他看了什么画而说这话。

en.t: The Eldest Princess did not know what picture he had seen to make him say such a thing.

units.source_text: 他就把那幅画卷好，从帷屏的隙缝里塞进去给她看。

en.t: So he rolled up that picture and slipped it through a gap in the curtain screen for her to see.

units.source_text: 大公主俯首看画，头发袅娜地挂在席地上，稍稍溢出在帷屏之外。

en.t: The Eldest Princess bent her head to look at the picture, and her hair fell gracefully onto the mat, spilling a little beyond the curtain screen.

units.source_text: 匂皇子隐约窥见姿色，觉得越看越美。

en.t: Prince Niou caught a faint glimpse of her beauty and felt that she grew more beautiful the longer he looked.

units.source_text: 他想：“假使此人对我血统稍远些……”难于隐忍，便赋诗云：

en.t: He thought, "If only this person were a little more distant from me in blood..." Unable to restrain himself, he composed a poem:
